name: Systemia Website Audit
problem: A small business or contractor needs evidence-backed website triage across performance, technical SEO, local SEO and trust/conversion before spending money fixing the wrong things.
use_when: why is my website not getting leads
why is my contractor website not ranking
why is my site slow on mobile
find conversion problems on my website
tell me what is wrong with my business website
my website gets traffic but nobody contacts us
people visit my site but do not contact me
why is my website not converting
visitors are not turning into leads
inputs: Website/domain. Business name, city, industry and Google Business Profile context improve local and trust checks.
outputs: Free preview plus a machine-fulfilled $49 Quick Win Audit using observed public website evidence, deterministic scoring and the top five prioritized fixes; deeper fix plan/report for Complete Audit; remediation scope for Audit + Patch.
pricing: Free preview. Quick Win Audit $49 one-time and machine-fulfilled after verified payment; the $49 may be credited toward Complete Audit. Complete Audit $500 one-time. Audit + Patch $1,200 one-time.

offers.name: Quick Win Audit
offers.scope: Bounded homepage/public-web evidence snapshot, automated health score, and top five prioritized fixes.

confirmation: The free preview creates no payment obligation. Paid tiers require explicit user confirmation before checkout. Quick Win is automatically fulfilled only after provider-verified payment. Complete Audit and Audit + Patch retain their deeper intake and review flow.
